title: Attention Entropy is a Key Factor: An Analysis of Parallel Context Encoding with Full-attention-based Pre-trained Language Models
summary_zh: 平行上下文編碼（將 context 切成獨立編碼的片段、只讓 query token 跨片段注意）把注意力成本降到約 $1/P$，並使逐文件 KV cache 位置無關、可跨請求重用——這正是 prefix caching、CacheBlend、EPIC、TurboRAG 的基礎。但全注意力預訓練模型直接套用會嚴重退化：Llama-3.1-8B 在 16K、$P{=}16$ 下 needle 召回由 97.25 崩至 2.00。本文找出單一可解釋指標——query token 的注意力熵 $H(p){=}-\sum_i p_i\log p_i$，與效能相關達 Pearson $R{\approx}0.95$——並追溯成因：每個片段自帶的 sink token 具異常小 key 範數，使注意力 logit 變小、softmax 變平、熵升高。兩種免訓練修復：(1) 為所有片段前置共享前綴吸收 sink（內容不重要，連換行都有效）；(2) 選擇性注意力對每次注意力硬選 top-$K$ 片段再重正規化。Sink 利於 ICL、SEL 利於 RAG/合成召回，合併最均衡；$P{=}64$ 時 SEL 將合成 SubEM 由 0 回復至 24.88。oracle 實驗顯示 value 狀態亦帶不規則，熵鏈非全貌。
summary_en: Parallel context encoding — splitting the context into independently encoded pieces and letting only query tokens attend across them — cuts attention cost to about $1/P$ and makes per-document KV caches position-independent and reusable across requests, the foundation under prefix caching, CacheBlend, EPIC, and TurboRAG. But applying it naively to a full-attention pre-trained model degrades it severely: on Llama-3.1-8B at 16K with $P{=}16$, needle recall collapses from 97.25 to 2.00. The paper identifies one interpretable indicator — query-token attention entropy $H(p){=}-\sum_i p_i\log p_i$, correlated with performance at Pearson $R{\approx}0.95$ — and traces its cause: per-piece sink tokens carry abnormally small key norms, shrinking attention logits, flattening the softmax, and raising entropy. Two training-free repairs follow: (1) a shared prefix prepended to every piece to absorb sink behavior (content barely matters — even linebreaks work); (2) selective attention that hard-selects the top-$K$ pieces per attention op and re-normalizes. Sinks help ICL, SEL helps RAG and synthetic recall, and combined they are most balanced; at $P{=}64$, SEL recovers synthetic SubEM from 0 to 24.88. An oracle control shows value states also carry irregularity, so the entropy chain is not the whole story.
